items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 27, 2013 [interview 2 of 2]…
items.q: songs that I really love from the classics, I mean as well as Gershwin and Porter and everybody else

ctx.x: Well you’ve got a play in the future, a musical. Have you got any recording plans coming up soon?

Yes. Yes. I have a very ambitious project for myself. I am just getting into computerized recording now, and I’m going to create a whole series of recordings of just bass — solo bass songs of Ellington of this, that and the other thing, of different styles of music. I’m going to take also some classical themes and work on them, and see if I can play the classical themes and then find accompaniments to them, improvised accompaniments to them. And it’s songs that I really love from the classics, I mean as well as…
